builder_script:
set -u
cd /src
export CARGO_HOME=/cargo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/target RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' RUST_BACKTRACE=0
lane() { name=$1; shift; s=$(date +%s); sh -c "$1" > /out/lane-$name.log 2>&1; echo $? > /out/lane-$name.exit; echo $(( $(date +%s) - s )) > /out/lane-$name.seconds; }
start=$(date +%s)
LCR_DUMP=/out/tuples.jsonl cargo test --all-features --no-fail-fast --locked -j 8 > /out/test.log 2>&1
echo $? > /out/test.exit
echo $(( $(date +%s) - start )) > /out/test.seconds
start=$(date +%s)
cargo build --all-features --locked -j 8 --example lcr_adapter > /out/adapter.log 2>&1
code=$?
echo $code > /out/adapter.exit
echo $(( $(date +%s) - start )) > /out/adapter.seconds
if [ $code -eq 0 ]; then cp /target/debug/examples/lcr_adapter /out/adapter; fi
lane selectors 'cargo test -p parcel_selectors --locked -j 8'
lane no-default-features 'cargo check -p lightningcss --no-default-features --lib --locked -j 8'
lane wasm-check 'cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p lightningcss_node --locked -j 8'
lane c-bindings 'cp c/lightningcss.h /tmp/lightningcss.h.orig && cargo build -p lightningcss_c_bindings --locked -j 8 && diff -u /tmp/lightningcss.h.orig c/lightningcss.h'
